description: Suggestions for someone who has not decided yet: 'what should I do tonight?', 'ko darīt Rīgā šodien?', 'kur aiziet brīvdienās?', 'ideas for the weekend with kids'. Returns a short varied list: events popular on EventApp first, then one of each kind (concert, theatre, cinema, exhibition…) before a second of any, each with why it was picked. Today by default; when, city, interests (free words in Latvian or English), free_only and from_time narrow it.

city.description: City or town in Latvia (pilsēta), e.g. Rīga, Riga, Liepāja, Jūrmala, Cēsis. Diacritics optional. list_cities names them all.

free_only.description: Only events known to be free of charge.

from_time.description: Only showings starting at or after this Riga clock time, HH:MM (e.g. 18:00 for 'this evening'). All-day events are kept.

interests.description: What the person likes, in their words, e.g. 'jazz', 'bērniem', 'theatre', 'kino'. Optional.

when.description: A named window in Riga time: today, tomorrow, weekend (Friday to Sunday; on a weekend day, what is left of it), week (today to Sunday), upcoming (everything ahead). Overrides date_from/date_to.

name: suggest_events
title: Suggest things to do
